overview.text: The easiest way to collect testimonials and add them to your website. Get started for free.

offerings.text: The easiest way to collect testimonials and add them to your website. Get started for free.
Create your form, customize it and add your personalized intro video. With Senja you'll collect twice as many testimonials.
The perfect testimonial for every pitch, page and post. With Senja you'll have one place for all your proof, ready for you and your team to share.

problems.text: Spending too much time manually collecting and formatting client testimonials
Difficulty leveraging customer reviews effectively on their websites
Lack of consolidated, easy testimonial collection slowing marketing efforts

valueProposition.text: Senja is a simple self-serve tool enabling solo marketers to quickly collect and organize testimonials, saving time and boosting client trust without complex setup.

differentiators.text: Comparative advantage is unvalidated. Test Senja is a simple self-serve tool enabling solo marketers to quickly collect and organize testimonials, saving time and boosting client trust without complex setup. against the buyer's current workaround.
